podcast.body: Charlie Fach, head of Bachman-Turner Overdrive's label, cited his past success in recognizing the hit potential of Rod Stewart's "Maggie May," despite its seven-and-a-half-minute length which ordinarily would preclude it from being a single. "I discovered Maggie May for Rod Stewart and that shouldn't have been a single because it was like seven and a half minutes long."
